name: raea
description: Make video, motion graphics, games and 3D scenes with raea, the Render Anything Engine: the raea skill, the video-decompiler skill (a short product film made from a good film of its kind, by James Dimachkie), skills for Bevy 0.20 (by Chris Gliddon), Blender (by EL4CTEO) and three.js (from gamedev-skills), and hooks that run raea's quick check on a composition after it's saved and show media in the raea app instead of the Mac's viewer.
